tool_description: Retrieve real-time and historical stock market performance using Yahoo Finance data.

api_list.name: get_stock_data
api_list.description: Fetches current price, percentage change, and period highs for a given stock. Optionally returns market metadata such as market cap, P/E ratio, dividend yield, and sector information.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The time window for historical data.

parameters.name: include_info
parameters.description: If set to true, returns additional company metadata like market cap, P/E ratio, and sector.
